issue.title: tests/test_force_reuse_launch_seam.py: 2 tests assert a segment_extra_env kwarg that launch_query only passes when it is not None
issue.description:
Two tests fail deterministically on clean master HEAD 30077550b (verified with `git stash -u`, so no working-tree diff is involved):

  FAILED tests/test_force_reuse_launch_seam.py::test_plain_sase_run_without_request_sidecar_still_rejects_forced_reuse
  FAILED tests/test_force_reuse_launch_seam.py::test_sidecar_without_authorization_still_rejects_forced_reuse
  2 failed, 5 passed in 2.31s

ROOT CAUSE (precise). Both tests funnel through the `_run_launch_query_unauthorized` helper, whose final assertion is tests/test_force_reuse_launch_seam.py:227:

    mock_launch.assert_called_once_with(prompt, segment_extra_env=None)

Production never makes that call. src/sase/main/query_handler/_launch.py:112-115 branches on the value instead of always passing it:

    if segment_extra_env is not None:
        results = launch_agents_from_cwd(query, segment_extra_env=segment_extra_env)
    else:
        results = launch_agents_from_cwd(query)

On the unauthorized path there is no force-reuse plan, so `segment_extra_env` keeps its `None` initializer (_launch.py:82) and the else branch runs. The mock therefore records `launch_agents_from_cwd('%id:!foo\nDo work')` while the test expects the kwarg form:

    E  AssertionError: expected call not found.
    E  Expected: launch_agents_from_cwd('%id:!foo\nDo work', segment_extra_env=None)
    E    Actual: launch_agents_from_cwd('%id:!foo\nDo work')

The five passing tests in the file all take the authorized path, where `segment_extra_env` is a real dict and the kwarg branch runs — which is why the file is only half red.

PROVENANCE: both the assertion and the branch arrived in dc4ca2057 ('fix(agent): restore forced agent-name-reuse launches for Agents-tab `,x` kill-and-edit'), the second-most-recent commit on master.

SCOPE: decide which side is authoritative and make the two agree. Either drop the branch and always pass `segment_extra_env=segment_extra_env` (simplest; `launch_agents_from_cwd` already accepts `None` on the authorized path when a plan carries no segment envs — confirm that first), or relax the helper's assertion to `assert_called_once_with(prompt)` for the unauthorized case. Do not paper over it by asserting on `call_args[0]` only; the point of the assertion is that the untouched, still-`!` prompt reaches child validation unchanged.

IMPACT: every agent's mandatory `just check` is red at the test stage for a diff unrelated to launch seams. Discovered while running the scoped test lane for an unrelated split of src/sase/ace/tui/proc_observer.py.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-ng — in-progress task/epic retiring the dead ACE in-process launch bodies. Not a duplicate: sase-ng is about production/test divergence in the proc_callable seam, this is a plain call-signature mismatch. Named because sase-ng's +1 evidence cites the same kill_and_edit_force_reuse plan that landed dc4ca2057, so a worker there will be reading the same force-reuse launch path.
